execution.failure_rule: Any input-preparation failure stops all calls, preserving all77statusrows; either technicalcontrol mismatch/failure stops all77panelcalls. Once admitted to annotation only, per-genome caller/output errors retained and remaining independent genomes still attempted, without retry/flag substitution.
execution.resource_scope: Serial caller child timings and cumulative child peak RSS; not total workflow memory
execution.source_preservation: Verify source hashes before/aftereachcall and globallybefore/afterexecution; inputFASTA hashes before/aftercaller.

interpretation: Per-genome computational gene predictions using prior per-kind callers. Inputs and FAA/GFF coordinate inventories are verified; this is neither biological validation nor source admission. Prodigal single-mode internal training remains within each individual genome.
